title: Nobody Came Back
html:
Sergeant Ilsa Varne of the Underleaf watch sent two scouts into the orc compound north of the hollow. Neither returned.

About

Given bySergeant Ilsa Varne
Level11
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points2

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Sergeant Ilsa Varne (outdoors near Underleaf) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 10 orcs (10)
  3. Find Pell Rook inside Orc Lair
  4. Report to Sergeant Ilsa Varne at -62, 206

Rewards

Reward
Gold360
Character XP16,000
Quest points2

What Sergeant Ilsa Varne says

Pell Rook: You're not an orc. Good. Cut the rope, would you? My hands went dead a day ago.

You: Ilsa sent me. Where's the other scout?

Pell Rook: Tamsin. They took her down the stairs the first night. I heard her arguing with them all the way to the bottom.

Pell Rook: There's something else. There's a forge going on the fourth floor down, day and night. I counted the hammer strokes. They're making spearheads, more than this camp could ever carry.

Pell Rook: Tell Ilsa. I'll find my own way out once the feeling's back in my feet.

Sergeant Ilsa Varne: Pell's alive. That's one.

You: He says they took Tamsin further down. And they have a forge going on the fourth floor.

Sergeant Ilsa Varne: A forge. Spearheads don't stay in a camp for long. They go somewhere, and the only road near that compound is ours.

Sergeant Ilsa Varne: Take your pay. I'll need to think about what comes next, and I'll need you when I've decided.

Handing it in

"Take your pay. I'll need to think about what comes next, and I'll need you when I've decided."
